{"id": "6701e1fc-ec00-4278-b632-5a077af861e8", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Here's what I found in your account (`111122223333`, us-east-1) for Claude-related Bedrock quotas — all of these are adjustable:

| Quota | Current Value |
|---|---|
| Cross-region model inference **tokens**/min — Claude Opus 4.6 V1 | 3,000,000 |
| Global cross-region model inference **requests**/min — Claude Sonnet 4.6 | 10,000 |
| Cross-region model inference **requests**/min — Claude Haiku 4.5 | 10,000 |

Since you're hitting `ThrottlingException` on `InvokeModel`, you're almost certainly bumping into one of the **requests-per-minute** or **tokens-per-minute** quotas for the specific Claude model you're calling (and possibly the specific region/cross-region config you're using — the exact quota name depends on whether you're calling a model directly in one region or via cross-region inference).

**To raise it:**
1. Identify exactly which Claude model ID and region/endpoint is throttling (check the `ThrottlingException` message or CloudTrail/CloudWatch for the model ARN).
2. Go to **Service Quotas → Amazon Bedrock**, find the matching quota (e.g., "Cross-region model inference requests per minute for Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6" or the tokens-per-minute equivalent).
3. Submit a quota increase request. Since these are marked `Adjustable: true`, it goes through Service Quotas / Support.
4. In the request, include: quota name, model ID, region, use case, and your projected steady-state and peak requests/tokens per minute — approval depends on this.
5. If you request the **tokens-per-minute** quota increase specifically, AWS Support will also follow up offering to raise the related "Cross-Model Max Tokens Per Day" quota at the same time.

One important note: AWS prioritizes increase requests from accounts that are already consuming close to their existing quota — so if you're nowhere near 10,000 req/min today, make sure your request explains the burst pattern causing the throttling (steady vs. peak).

Want me to pull your actual request/token consumption from CloudWatch over the last few hours so you can include real numbers in the quota request?", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
